sources.note: TabRank distills DeepSeek-R1 reranking rationales into a Qwen3-8B listwise table reranker by placing the teacher's reasoning trace in the student's input prompt and computing loss only over the final ranking, rather than training the student to reproduce the trace.
sources.title: TabRank: Chain-of-Thought Distillation for Table Re-Rankers

sources.note: DC-CoT is a benchmark that isolates the effect of data augmentation, data selection and data mixing on chain-of-thought distillation into smaller student models, across teacher models, student models and reasoning domains.
sources.title: The Quest for Efficient Reasoning: A Data-Centric Benchmark to CoT Distillation

sources.note: PIR scores reasoning steps by their effect on answer confidence and prunes only low-importance verification/error-correction steps from distilled chain-of-thought data, producing models that reason more concisely without losing accuracy.
sources.title: LIMOPro: Reasoning Refinement for Efficient and Effective Test-time Scaling

result.definition: Training a smaller student model on the reasoning traces a larger teacher produced, which the archive's sources treat as a data problem rather than a fixed recipe. DC-CoT benchmarks it as exactly that, isolating the contribution of data augmentation, data selection and data mixing across teacher models, student models and reasoning domains; LIMOPro's PIR scores each step of the distilled traces by its effect on answer confidence and prunes only the low-importance verification and error-correction steps, so the student reasons more concisely at unchanged accuracy. The sources do not agree that the student should reproduce the trace at all: TabRank places DeepSeek-R1's reranking rationale in the Qwen3-8B student's input prompt and takes the loss only over the final ranking, so the teacher's reasoning is conditioning rather than a target. What the term shares across all three is only the teacher-trace-to-smaller-student direction; the objective, and how much of the trace survives, is what each paper varies.
